comment: In-run draft boost cards, PDTD-style: percentage buffs and trade-off picks, offered alongside the weapon-level cards. 'requires' gates a card on a weapon being active (kind from data/orbital_weapons.json, or a hero weapon id). Effect keys are ModifierSet.ApplyEffect keys.

cards.name: Field Amplifier
cards.text: Sentinel blast, beam and zone radius +40%.

cards.name: Relay Expansion
cards.text: +1 Radiation Link relay — but each link deals 20% less damage.

cards.name: Refraction Optics
cards.text: The ship laser refracts to +5 more enemies (damage falls off per bounce).

cards.name: Multi-Launch
cards.text: The battery fires +2 missiles per salvo.

radline_note: Radiation Link behaviour (rotate / end-burst / endpoint lasers) is gated on the weapons LEVEL in data/orbital_weapons.json (rotate_level, burst_level, node_shot_level), mirroring PDTD, whose own cards for these carry needLevel 2/0/0 and are drafted per-weapon. They were briefly boost cards here; four extra always-eligible boost cards measurably crowded weapon levelling out of the draft (SimTest endless fell from wave 41 to 5), so they move back to level gates until the per-weapon skill-card draft lands.
